finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 37 touch users. One feature, 26 fixes, 10 perf.

Two breaking items nobody labeled breaking:

| Change | Why it breaks |
|---|---|
| `fix(auth)` returns `401` not `403` | Callers matching `403` for expired tokens |
| `refactor(api)` dropped the v1 export route | It was called "unused" |

The feature is webhook retry with backoff. It also touched `src/core/config.js`, so check for new config keys before you ship.

Perf has no heading in your shape. I folded it into `Fixed` as one line.

Next: confirm the v1 export route really had no callers.
